info.title: API-DocTest-List Investment Portfolio Deposits-v4-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Deposits API provides essential functionality for retrieving detailed information about deposits made to investment portfolios. This API allows financial analysts and account managers to access a comprehensive list of deposits, including amounts, dates, and associated portfolios. Typical use cases include reporting, portfolio performance analysis, and transaction tracking. Users can leverage this data to make informed investment decisions and enhance portfolio management strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve deposit information for a specified portfolio.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about deposits associated with a specific portfolio. Use this to analyze deposit transactions, amounts, and related portfolio metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a deposit operation within the portfolio. It requires the client to send specific details that represent the deposit transaction such as the amount and currency. The provided data will be processed to effectuate the deposit request.

200.description: The request was successful, and the deposit information has been retrieved.
